name: Call of the Wild: Wolfrider Yara stands at the Valley of Trials turn-in spot and takes the quest (#8667)
contract: Report #8667: a level 7 Ranger at (-593.06, -4212.63, 38.99) in the Valley of Trials found no NPC to turn in Call of the Wild 52009.

52009 (Ranger only, class mask 1048576) ends at Wolfrider Yara 502810. Her spawn 9003508 at (-591.5, -4209.8, 39.0) is 3.2 yd from the report point and belongs to the CoA class trainer event 195, which AscensionFreepick starts on a ConquestOfAzeroth realm.

Expected: with event 195 running, exactly one living Wolfrider Yara stands within reach of the report point, and a Ranger holding 52009 with the Tribal Guide 54009 turns it in to her through the questgiver packet handlers.

steps.label: SETUP: join world phase 1, the phase the Valley of Trials spawns live in
SETUP: the CoA class trainer event 195 is running, as on a CoA realm
DISCRIMINATING: exactly one living Wolfrider Yara is at the turn-in spot
SETUP: Cutting Teeth, the prerequisite, is ready to turn in
SETUP: Call of the Wild is ready to turn in with the Tribal Guide
Hand Call of the Wild in at Wolfrider Yara
DISCRIMINATING: Call of the Wild is rewarded at Yara
